title: Chapter 406
paragraphs: Chapter 406
Episode 119. The Banquet of the Imperial Sword Castle (11)
Despite his head being shattered, the Underworld King did not fall. He swung his fist wrapped in thunder energy at Jin.
Jin deflected the Underworld King's fist with the hilt of his sword while returning Sigmund to its original position.
As the fist was forced downward, the Underworld King's front was exposed, and Jin thrust his sword blade in.
Thud! The sword pierced through his chest, but the Underworld King did not fall. Instead, he grabbed the blade with both hands to prevent Jin from moving.
Two other Underworld Kings rushed in. Jin quickly assessed their attack trajectories and split the first Underworld King's body in half, deflecting the incoming attacks.
Their movements weren't bad.
The moment Jin dodged, the Underworld Kings had adjusted the trajectory of their fists. It was a movement difficult for even skilled warriors to imitate.
'Those who were just mages now have movements like top-tier warriors. Their regenerative abilities seem to be almost immortal.'
On top of that, there was the annoying power of thunder energy.
Anger and frustration welled up from deep within his chest.
The Underworld King, whose head was shattered and body split in half, was quickly regenerating his flesh.
The escorts of Beradin spat out in disgust at the bizarre sight.
The first gray-robed figure who had died was the same. Although he had clearly stopped breathing, he eventually stood up again, and a blue energy shone from the gem in his chest.
The four mages, now Underworld Kings, no longer seemed to be able to use magic.
"Did you desire such a fake power, even if it meant denying your entire life as a mage?"
At Jin's cold voice, the Underworld Kings burst into laughter.
"A mere mortal can't call the immortal body a fake..."
"What are you laughing at, are you insane?"
Swish-!

As Sigmund drew a line, the Underworld King's head that had just stood up rolled on the floor. The severed head was incinerated with a flame jewel, and the King's Sword waterfall technique was thrust into the body.

Thunder energy entwined around the sword poured down, covering the Underworld King. When the torrent of thunder energy had completely passed, only a large pit remained where the Underworld King had stood.
Only a few charred small lumps were scattered nearby.
It was unimaginable that these were once flesh and bones that constituted life.
However, Jin intuitively felt that it was not the end, and the Underworld Kings did not stop laughing.
"You seem to not know the definition of immortality, 12th generation of Runecandel."
The charred flesh quickly regained its original color.
The scattered bones and organs, whose whereabouts were unknown, were being reformed from the void where the Underworld King had stood.
The Underworld Kings seemed quite proud of this fact, guessing that Jin's emotionless face was shocked by it.
To Jin, it was simply disgusting. It sent shivers down his spine as if a cockroach had suddenly crawled out from the head of the bed.
Reflexively, as if to crush the bug.
He struck the regenerating body with lightning once more. Since the other Myeongin didn't protect him, he had to scatter his body in all directions again while defenseless.
And then, the regeneration continued.
Around that time, the Myeongin began to wear expressions of intoxication from a sense of victory, beyond just pride.
Ordinarily.
By this point, they would have been gripped by an unknown fear. They would have felt the instinct to run away, thinking they had encountered an enemy that could not be killed no matter what they did.
The Myeongin naturally assumed Jin would react that way too. He was only nineteen, and he had no experience fighting immortal opponents.
"Haah."
Jin sighed, shrugging his shoulders.
"You guys are really something. Immortal? This is just super-regeneration, you're no longer human or anything, just hybrid freaks."
Jin had seen super-regeneration before. Just recently, he had fought the ancient inner demon Ozdok, which also possessed this super-regenerative ability.
"It's laughable that so-called Grand Magicians are being seduced by such a vain power."
Crack, tssss!
Suddenly, ice crystals formed in Jin's palm. The ice crystals repeated cycles of growing and shrinking, creating an ominous sound.
"You can't kill us anyway."
"Is that so?"
The Myeongin still seemed unaware of the situation.
'Was it like this, probably?'
The ice barrier magic Jin had deployed was something his master, Valeria Hester, had used.
Ice Barrier Seal.
Jin recalled the sight of Valeria sealing Bement's dead body in the Wantarumo Forest.
'I asked a few times because it seemed like a versatile magic… but I'm not sure if I can succeed at once.'
Back then, when he had spent a few days with Yona and Valeria after leaving the Wantarumo Forest, Jin had sought magical advice from Valeria whenever he had the chance.
At that time, he remembered hearing a few clues about the ice barrier seal magic.

-"The Ice Barrier Seal magic can be used by anyone. However, to properly seal and maintain it, you must know how to completely separate your magic power from within your body. You're forming a kind of lock with that separated magic."
-"How do you separate the magic power?"
-"It's hard to explain. I gave you a simple concept, so try practicing on your own."
Valeria's explanation had been flawed from the beginning.
Among the ice barrier magic, the seal boasted the highest level of difficulty. From the start, only a very small number of ice barrier specialists could handle the seal.
Moreover, maintaining the seal as intended was an entirely different domain. The seals of ordinary magicians only lasted until their magic power ran out.
Valeria was known to be the most talented magician in the world. And Jin was her only disciple who she acknowledged.
Separating the magic power from within the body.
Suddenly, he remembered his first mission as a novice.
'Back then, when I fought Kwajito Truka and unlocked my sword with spiritual energy, I also separated the energy from my body when it went out of control. I think it's a similar sensation.'
He felt it. The ice crystals on his palm, which had been changing randomly, gradually stabilized.
"You won't die. Instead, you'll be sealed and become research subjects."
As Jin reached out, a white aura poured out of the ice crystals and wrapped around the regenerating Myeongin.
Snap!
The frozen Myeongin seemed to stop regenerating instantly.
What was horrifying, however, was that the heart of the Myeongin wrapped in ice was still beating.
He sprinkled more magic power, using the separated power from within the body to maintain the seal.
He felt that no more of his magic power was being consumed, which meant success.
'It worked on the first try. In my past life, when learning from my master, nothing ever came this easy.'

He sealed the remaining unregenerated bodies in the same way. As the ice crystals sealing various parts of the Myeongin's body spilled onto the floor, the remaining Myeongin's laughter faded from their faces.
"It seems like you guys are the ones who don't know the definition of immortality, right?"

"If you think that having an infinitely regenerating body is immortality, it's because your world is limited to that. Do you think humans like me have always denied what you guys have worked for your whole lives?"
Jin burst into a grin.
"You guys denied yourselves, just because you have no more will to achieve anything. And, is the measure of one's life value always determined by the degree of idleness?"
"… Your magic power isn't infinite, anyway. You won't be able to keep maintaining that seal."

"You're still delusional. I can keep going, I just don't need to. You guys will be handed over to the research magicians, sealed and dismembered. From then on, your juniors will take care of maintaining the new seals for you."
For a moment.
The Myeongin felt their 'immortality' was far away.
As Jin said, if they were to end up in a magician's research lab, the fact that they couldn't die as they wished would become a terrible curse.
The Myeongin who was particularly afraid of that fact started running away first.
Trying to escape.
"Where do you think you're going?"
The shot sword energy cut off both his legs. Regeneration happened quickly, but fear-stricken hearts couldn't regenerate.
His reattached legs wouldn't move. His fear-driven, reflexive lightning was not only spreading randomly, but it was also threatening the other Myeongin.
"Tsk."
While the other Myeongin avoided his lightning, Jin skillfully infiltrated between them and swung Sigmund.
It didn't take long to dismember them into a good shape for sealing.
'It's even more annoying when they were magicians.'
Watching the chaotic lightning strikes indiscriminately, he felt a bitter feeling.
The fact that many strong people in the world were abandoning themselves to the false promises of Kinzelona Zifel.
Sizzle, snap, crack...!
Soon, all the Myeongin were lying on the ground, trapped in Jin's ice barrier seal.
"Hey."
Jin turned around and called Veradin's guards.
"You guys go back to Sword Emperor Castle separately. I'll take Veradin first. Shuri, bite all of these."
[Myaah!]
Shuri bit a mouthful of seals, and Jin climbed on top of her and reached out to Veradin.
Veradin stared at his hand for a moment.
"I can't believe you were defeated by these. Considering how you fought with me in the Bentica conflict zone."
It was unbelievable.

The fact that he didn't ask for help from the start, and that Veradin was driven to the brink of death by these guys. With the power Veradin showed in Bentica, he could have easily dealt with these Myeongin.
The more he thought about it, the more Jin doubted Veradin. To be precise, he doubted Zifel, who was controlling him.
"That wasn't me back then, Jin."
"It can be the same now. My previous proposal is still valid."
-I have a suggestion for you.
-What is it?
-Abandon the name Zifel.
The words he proposed at the end of the reserve period, in Veradin's villa.
The two of them thought of that moment at the same time.
Without answering, Veradin held Jin's hand and climbed onto Shuri.
The two did not have any other conversation until they returned to the Sword Emperor Castle.
It was because Veradin couldn't stand the bleeding and passed out, but it would have been the same even if he had been awake in a normal state.
